name: cyclin Q
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
regulation of cell cycle G2/M phase transition

function.text: CCNQ encodes cyclin-Q. Annotated molecular activities include cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of cell cycle G2/M phase transition.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndactyly-telecanthus-anogenital and renal malformations syndrome (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
